explanation: The prophet and leader of the people of Israel, who received the law from God on Mount Sinai.
The instructions and commandments given by God to Moses and the people of Israel to guide their lives and society.
The promised land of Canaan, where God led the people of Israel after leaving Egypt.
Mount Sinai, the place where Moses received the law from God.
The people of Israel, also known as Hebrews, who were led by Moses through the wilderness toward the promised land.
